name: 07008 · Carteret, NJ
findings: ZIP 07008 (Carteret) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07008 (Carteret) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07008 (Carteret) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.
